title: The 7 best meeting scheduler apps in 2026
summary: There are quite a few different flavors of meeting scheduler apps, and after testing as many as possible, here we'll present you with our picks for the best.
body_markdown:

Calendly


End-to-end meeting management


Scheduling handled entirely by cc'ing Callie in email threads


Free plan available; paid plans start at $10/month


[Visit Calendly](https://calendly.com/)


****Calendar


Appointments in a calendar app


Multiple workspaces


From $16/month


[Visit Calendar](https://www.calendar.com/)


****SavvyCal


Mixing polling with a standard scheduling tool


Option for invitees to automatically overlay their calendars within the polling page


Free plan available; paid plans start at $10/user/month


[Visit SavvyCal](https://vendors.selectsoftwarereviews.com/redirect/1749163650181x640669422786707500?p=1715808885462x244895206427328500)


****zcal


A free option

[Visit zcal](https://vendors.selectsoftwarereviews.com/redirect/1761938173450x423389432625758200?p=1715808885462x244895206427328500)


****Reclaim


Priority-based scheduling


Great analytics and team features


Free plan available; paid plans start at $10/user/month
